description: This file defines a Serializable immutable data class 'StaffData' representing staff information within the Fineract project. It includes fields like id, externalId, name, contact info, office details, and status flags, along with factory methods for creation and lookup.

classes.name: StaffData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing staff data, providing various factory methods for instantiation and accessors for staff attributes.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a StaffData object for import purposes, initializing core staff details along with row index, locale, and date format.

methods.name: templateData
methods.description: Creates a template StaffData object, enriching the base staff data with allowed offices information.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Creates a minimal StaffData object with id and displayName, used for referencing existing staff.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a fully populated StaffData object with detailed staff information, including office and status flags.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Getter for the transient rowIndex field used during import.
